name: – Georgios Aftias – Proposal for a decision
title: Mobilisation of the European Union Solidarity Fund: assistance to Italy, Slovenia, Austria, Greece and France relating to six natural disasters occurred in 2023
part_text:
The European Parliament approves giving €1.03 billion from the European Union Solidarity Fund to five countries hit by floods in 2023. Italy gets money for Emilia-Romagna and Tuscany, Slovenia and Austria for August floods, Greece for Storm Daniel, and France for Nord-Pas-de-Calais. The report also asks the Commission to pay faster, to protect islands and coastal regions, and to spend more on preventing disasters, since the fund only pays for damage after it happens.

- **What changes:** €1.03 billion in EU aid is released for six floods in 2023.
- **Who it affects:** Italy, Slovenia, Austria, Greece and France, and people in the flooded areas.
- **What happens next:** The Parliament and Council sign the decision, and the money is paid out.
